card.name: Pivot to opinion or feeling clause
card.fires_on: Small words that start a new clause right after a statement, such as I, 'm, and, but, or a period. The next words tend to give a feeling, opinion or guess.

modes.label: First-person feeling
modes.description: I or 'm opening a statement of feeling after a personal fact.
modes.example: My mother died and my father works abroad all year.<< I>>'m happy when my granddad isn't

modes.label: Joining word before a guess
modes.description: And or but after a clause about what is unknown, leading into speculation or a comment.

modes.label: Contraction before judgment
modes.description: Part of a contraction such as 's or 'm leading into an evaluation or hope.

card.writes: It seems to nudge the output toward words of liking, favor and belief.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before a sentence goes on to say what someone feels, likes or guesses.
